note: target_specific_reloc_handling() (binutils/readelf.c) computes `start + reloc->r_offset` from an attacker-controlled relocation's r_offset field (from a crafted ELF/object file) and passes it to the byte_put function pointer (bound to byte_put_little_endian(), elfcomm.c), in 4 symbol-difference-relocation branches: MSP430 (line 11640), MN10300 (11677), RL78_ABS32 (11712), RL78_ABS16 (11717). byte_put_little_endian's field[N] = ... writes land past the allocated section buffer when start + reloc->r_offset exceeds it.

traces.message: byte_put(start + reloc->r_offset, value, reloc_size) : MSP430 sym-diff relocation
field[3] = (value >> 24) & 0xff; : byte_put_little_endian writes past the section buffer once start+r_offset exceeds its end
byte_put(start + reloc->r_offset, value, reloc_size) : MN10300 sym-diff relocation
field[3] = (value >> 24) & 0xff; : byte_put_little_endian writes past the section buffer once start+r_offset exceeds its end

field[3] = (value >> 24) & 0xff; : byte_put_little_endian writes past the section buffer once start+r_offset exceeds its end
